Questions
About connecting WhatsApp, supplier payments and credit.
What happens when I connect my WhatsApp?{i1}

You join the waitlist. Each business you invite moves you up the list, and we'll let you know when Rocoto is ready to try. Joining before launch gives you access to the early credit offer, subject to assessment and approval.
How does the 0% interest offer work?{i1}

Your first 3 loans have 0% interest for 7 days, up to S/500 each, when you join before launch. Rocoto covers the interest and fees; you repay the amount borrowed. Credit is subject to the financial institution's assessment and approval. See offer terms.
Do I need WhatsApp Business?{i1}
Yes. Rocoto connects to WhatsApp Business, the free app for businesses. You can transfer your existing number and chats to it.
How does Rocoto connect to my WhatsApp?{i1}
Rocoto connects through the official WhatsApp Business integration. Your app keeps working on your phone.
When will credit be available?{i1}

We're preparing working-capital credit for businesses like yours, with a financial institution supervised by the SBS. Join the waitlist and we'll let you know when applications open. Each loan is subject to assessment and approval.
How do I repay my credit?{i1}

Repayment is collected automatically from your Yape on the agreed date. Before confirming, you see the amount to repay, the payment date and the credit terms. The financial institution providing the credit sets these terms and is supervised by the SBS.
Does my supplier have to use Rocoto?{i1}
Your supplier registers the account where they want to receive payment and accepts the terms once. Payment confirmations then arrive in your chat with them.
What does Rocoto read from my WhatsApp?{i1}
Your individual conversations from the last 6 months. Group chats keep working as usual, and broadcast lists become read-only.
Is Rocoto a financial institution?{i1}

Rocoto is preparing working-capital credit for businesses like yours, with a financial institution supervised by the SBS. Businesses that already use Rocoto go first, and each business you bring moves you up the list.
